reasoning_content:
The build is progressing slowly, so I'm reviewing the installation guide to identify what infrastructure I can set up in the meantime. Most components are already in place—PostgreSQL with PostGIS, RabbitMQ, MapServer with GDAL, MinIO S3 with buckets, and Liquibase—but I still need to handle MapProxy and LDProxy, which are optional.

I'm planning to install Tomcat, MapProxy via pip, and ldproxy while the build continues, then focus on deploying the distribution zip, extracting workspaces, configuring JDBC, running Liquibase, and verifying the application. I should also double-check that MapServer can handle S3 access through GDAL, which I've already installed. Since the build is CPU-bound on dependency resolution and I'm waiting for it to complete, I'll move forward with the optional components in parallel.
